premises.text: Travel planning across Instagram, blogs, flight sites, and Airbnb maps is fragmented and leaves travelers paralyzed with irrelevant options
premises.evidence_span: Millions of sources and services have made a smooth travel planning process impossible

premises.text: Mapify is a personal travel guide platform where travelers access, create, and share visualizations of entire journeys and unify sources in one place
premises.evidence_span: We have built a platform enabling travelers anywhere to access, create, and share visualizations of entire travel journeys

premises.text: Personalization from traveler interests plus community-shared spots drives a relevant feed and destination search
premises.evidence_span: it'll ask you for at least four things you love about travel

premises.text: One-button planner generates itineraries ordering spots by transport and matching Airbnbs and needs like adapters
premises.evidence_span: Mapify pulls in hundreds of data points and generates a possible way of how your trip could look

premises.text: AI content engine matches tags with photos/text and sorts trips by geographic relevance, quality, and personal importance
premises.evidence_span: an AI content engine we've built matching hundreds of thousands of tags with photos, text, and attachments

premises.text: Monetization via brand and affiliate partnerships with leading travel brands, starting with European millennial leisure travel
premises.evidence_span: We are already generating revenue through brand and affiliate partnerships with some of the world's leading travel brands

value.text: Curate the most relevant places and personal experiences so travelers can create a whole journey in seconds
value.evidence_span: Mapify is your personal travel guide that lets you create your whole travel journey in just a few seconds

causal_links.evidence_span: too many options leave us totally paralyzed
curate the most relevant places and personal experiences
generating revenue through brand and affiliate partnerships

notes: Country/photo/tag counts treated as traction. Team/investor credentials excluded. 'Every traveler a global host' treated as platform mechanism within P2/P3, not vision premise. Anti-template: need/product/monetization separately revisable.
